title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Schedule for a Requested Room Move
content:
**Finance office clarification, room moves — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The new room's schedule — the private pay schedule whose rate prices the new-room span — follows how the move came about.

Until a scheduled rate takes effect for an agreement the earlier scheduled rate applies, save that the span posted for a room the resident asked to move into is priced at the current private pay schedule from its first day, a move the resident requests needing no advance rate-change notice, and only that span; every other charged day stays under that rule.

| How the move came about | New room's schedule |
|---|---|
| The resident's latest room-change request was logged on or before the move date recorded on the agreement (a move the resident asked for) | The current private pay schedule |
| Not so, and no rate notice delivery date is recorded on the agreement | The preceding schedule, a rate never noticed never applying |
| Not so, and a delivery date is recorded | The schedule in effect for the agreement on the recorded move date: current where the notice took effect on or before that date (on the later of 1 July 2026 and the delivery date plus 60 days), preceding otherwise |

The resident's latest room-change request is the one logged latest; where two were logged at the same moment, the one entered first.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical case.** A move the center directed, no request on file, notice delivered 30 days before a recorded move falling after 1 July 2026: the notice had not taken effect, so the preceding schedule.
